job.title: Collections Officer
job.description:
ABOUT THE COMPANY

Join a leading Australian financial services organisation with a strong reputation for delivering customer-focused lending solutions. Operating in a fast-paced and collaborative environment, this business is committed to helping customers navigate financial challenges while maintaining exceptional service standards. You'll be joining a supportive team that values accountability, resilience and professional development.

ABOUT THE ROLE

This is a fantastic opportunity for an experienced Collections Officer to hit the ground running in a busy, high-volume environment. Reporting to the Collections Manager, you'll play a key role in supporting customers with overdue accounts, negotiating suitable repayment arrangements and contributing to overall collections performance. Working alongside an energetic and driven team, you'll be trusted to manage customer interactions with empathy and professionalism while achieving collection targets.

DUTIES

  • Conduct outbound calls to recover overdue payments
  • Negotiate and establish suitable repayment plans with customers
  • Manage inbound enquiries from customers in arrears
  • Send collections documentation and correspondence as required
  • Maintain accurate customer records and account notes
  • Investigate account information and assist with skip tracing activities where required
  • Build positive customer relationships while achieving collection outcomes
  • Work efficiently in a fast-paced, high-volume environment

SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

  • Skip tracing experience desired but not essential.
  • Previous collections experience within a financial services or related environment
  • Strong negotiation, communication and conflict-resolution skills
  • Ability to manage high call volumes and work to targets
  • Excellent attention to detail and administrative skills
  • Strong problem-solving abilities and customer-focused approach
  • Ability to learn quickly and adapt to changing priorities

BENEFITS

  • Competitive hourly rate of $35-$40 per hour + super
  • Immediate start opportunity
  • Convenient Sydney CBD location
  • Gain experience with a well-established financial services organisation
  • Collaborative and supportive team environment
  • Potential contract extension for strong performers

job.title: Customer and Retention Specialist
job.description:

This Australian fintech supports thousands of small and medium businesses across hospitality, retail, healthcare and professional services. With a strong people-first culture, the business is known for its collaborative leadership, internal career progression and genuine investment in employee development. As the company continues to scale, customer experience and retention have become major strategic priorities - creating exciting opportunities for customer service professionals wanting to grow their careers in a modern, fast-paced environment.

This is a unique opportunity to join a newly expanded Strategic Accounts team focused on strengthening customer relationships and reducing churn across the business. Blending customer service, relationship management and problem-solving, you’ll work directly with business owners to understand challenges, investigate account activity and deliver tailored solutions.

This isn’t a scripted, high-volume environment. You’ll investigate accounts, review customer activity and understand merchant needs before reaching out - allowing you to have more strategic, relationship-focused conversations with business owners and genuinely influence customer outcomes.

  • Deliver tailored solutions to improve customer experience and strengthen loyalty

  • Previous experience within customer service, retention, account management or contact centre environments
  • Strong communication and rapport-building skills
  • Confidence handling difficult or solution-focused conversations
  • Ability to problem solve and investigate customer concerns independently
  • Commercial awareness and ability to balance customer and business outcomes
  • Resilient, adaptable and comfortable working within KPIs
  • Strong written communication and systems skills
  • Experience within fintech, banking, telco, complaints, collections, retail or consultative customer environments highly regarded
  • Proactive mindset with the ability to manage multiple conversations and follow-ups

  • Supportive, collaborative and social team culture

job.title: Executive Director of Members, Volunteers & Early Intervention
job.description:

  • Flexible location across NSW, with a preference for Sydney
  • Hybrid working with WFH flexibility, plus regular travel across NSW
  • Permanent, full time

ABOUT THE COMPANY
The St Vincent de Paul Society NSW, otherwise known as Vinnies, is one of Australia's best known charities. Grounded in its lay Catholic heritage, Vinnies works to reduce the impact of poverty and address injustice, offering a hand up to people experiencing disadvantage. Members, volunteers and staff work side by side in communities across NSW, delivering practical assistance, specialist services and advocacy. It is a values driven organisation where people are united by a shared mission and a genuine commitment to the communities they serve.

ABOUT THE ROLE
Reporting to the CEO as a member of the Executive Leadership Team, you will lead the Membership, Volunteers and Early Intervention directorate. This is the primary link between Vinnies and its members, from local Conferences through to State Council. You will lead five Regional Directors and a Director, Programs, and oversee major programs including Vinnies Vans, Disaster Recovery, NILS and the early intervention work of Conferences. You will shape the future of membership and build trust across a unique governance model.

DUTIES

  • Lead the directorate to deliver key priorities in the strategic plan and contribute to the next enterprise strategy
  • Build trusted, transparent relationships with the State Council President, State Council and Central Council Presidents
  • Drive member recruitment, renewal and retention so Conferences remain active and sustainable
  • Strengthen the experience and engagement of members and volunteers, supporting participation, connection and long-term sustainability
  • Develop and implement statewide member, youth and volunteer engagement strategies
  • Lead new ways of working, including regional operating model, to strengthen collaboration, consistency and connection across the Society
  • Oversee delivery of member programs including Conference assistance, WE CARE, NILS, Vinnies Vans and Disaster Recovery
  • Ensure quality and measurable community outcomes across member programs and early interventions services.
  • Represent Vinnies with government, ministers, major donors and corporate partners to grow funding and partnerships
  • Develop the capability of Regional Directors and their teams, leading people to be their best
  • Oversee directorate budgets, resources and performance, driving financial sustainability and continuous improvement.
  • Strengthen governance, compliance and risk management across members, volunteers and staff
  • Partner with Executive Directors across Services, Retail and Finance to deliver a "One Society" approach

SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

  • Senior executive experience leading large, dispersed teams and complex programs
  • Demonstrated ability to translate strategy into operational improvements and lead change across complex, geographically dispersed locations
  • Experience in a membership based organisation, union, peak body or similar environment
  • Exceptional stakeholder management and political judgement, with the maturity to anticipate issues early and negotiate outcomes
  • Credibility and confidence with government, funders and major donors
  • Strong understanding of governance, compliance and risk
  • Genuine alignment with the mission and respect for the Society's lay Catholic heritage and values
  • Relevant tertiary qualifications
  • Desirable: experience in the not for profit, social services or faith based sectors

BENEFITS

  • Generous salary package
  • PBI salary packaging to increase your take home pay

job.title: Life Insurance Administration Manager
job.description:
The Company

Lotus People are delighted to be partnering with a rapidly growing and innovative business operating within the life insurance and financial advice sector.

Having experienced significant growth over the past few years, this business provides a unique combination of licensing, technology and operational support to financial advice practices across Australia.

With a collaborative, energetic culture and a strong focus on innovation, they are passionate about empowering their people, embracing new technology and continuously improving the way they operate.

Based in a vibrant Surry Hills office, the team enjoys a supportive and social working environment, with regular team activities, wellness initiatives and opportunities for professional development.

The Role

An exciting opportunity has arisen for an experienced Life Insurance Administration Manager to take ownership of a key operational function within the business.

Leading a small team across Australia and offshore, you will oversee the day-to-day life insurance administration function, ensuring workflows are managed effectively, service standards are met and the team is supported to perform at its best.

This is a genuinely hands-on leadership opportunity, ideal for someone who enjoys mentoring others while remaining actively involved in complex cases, escalations and operational activities.

With the business continuing to grow, you will also play an important role in identifying efficiencies, streamlining processes and driving continuous improvement.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Lead, coach and develop a team of onshore and offshore life insurance administrators.
  • Oversee daily workflows, prioritise tasks and allocate workloads to ensure efficient service delivery.
  • Monitor team performance against SLAs, productivity targets and quality standards.
  • Manage outstanding requirements, suspense items, backlogs and complex or escalated cases.
  • Remain hands-on with life insurance administration, supporting the team wherever required.
  • Identify opportunities to improve processes, streamline workflows and enhance operational efficiency.
  • Ensure effective communication and handovers between onshore and offshore teams.
  • Work closely with senior leadership to drive team performance and continuous improvement.
  • Support the adoption of new systems, technology and automation initiatives.

About You
We are looking for a proactive, resilient and engaging leader who thrives in a fast-paced environment and enjoys making a difference.

You will bring strong administration experience within life insurance or a closely related financial services environment, alongside demonstrated experience leading, coaching or supervising others.

To be successful, you will ideally have:

  • Experience in life insurance administration, new business case management, financial planning, paraplanning, adviser support or practice management.
  • Previous team leadership or people management experience.
  • Strong understanding of administration workflows, outstanding requirements and case management processes.
  • A hands-on approach, with the confidence to manage complex cases and escalations.
  • Excellent organisational skills and the ability to manage competing priorities and high volumes.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to build relationships with internal and external stakeholders.
  • A proactive mindset with a passion for improving processes and driving efficiencies.
  • Confidence with technology and an interest in automation and innovative ways of working.

Above all, you will be someone who brings energy, accountability and initiative to the team. You will be comfortable sharing ideas, embracing change and rolling up your sleeves to get things done.

The Benefits

  • Join a rapidly growing business with exciting opportunities for career progression.
  • Genuine ownership of a team and the opportunity to influence operational improvements.
  • Work closely with an approachable and collaborative leadership team.
  • Vibrant Surry Hills office with a welcoming, energetic culture.
  • Team wellness initiatives, including group fitness activities.
  • Opportunity to contribute to technology, AI and process improvement initiatives.

How to Apply

If you're an experienced life insurance or financial services professional looking to take the next step in your leadership career, we'd love to hear from you!

APPLY NOW or reach out to Lotus People for a confidential discussion about this exciting opportunity.
